plot_image_single: plot a single numpy or PIL image using matplotlib with configurable size and colormap
plot_images_grid: plot multiple numpy or PIL images in a configurable grid layout with optional titles
test_plot_image: test the plot_image function with a numpy array and custom size parameters
test_plot_images_grid: test the plot_images_grid function with mixed PIL and numpy images in a grid
refactor_plot_images_grid: refactor the plot_images_grid function to support dynamic grid sizing based on image count
